name: cadrin
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original professional identity concept board for a real tutoring-center staff application: attendance, student activities, instructor handoffs, observations, progress history. Audience is adult staff; software coordinates learning rather than replacing tutors. Contemporary San Francisco software design with precise typography, memorable compact identity, restrained detail. Original design, do not copy existing startup logos. Landscape 1536x1024. Top 55%: one prominent large identity on pure dark charcoal with abundant breathing room. Bottom 45%: TWO equally sized small interface context studies side by side, same logo in both: left warm dark #242320 with chalk white and understated clay accent, calm spacious human-centered application; right cool near-black #101116 with silver text, fine gray separators and restrained indigo accent, compact precise engineering workspace. Each crop only top-left app corner, small sidebar labels Home / Students / Activity, quiet content heading "Center overview"; no student records, no metrics, no chat input or chatbot UI, no landing page marketing. Tiny panel labels "Warm workspace" and "Precision workspace". Identity mark and wordmark unchanged between panels; only surrounding UI changes. All text legible and carefully typeset. No animal, crest, metallic finish, bevel, engraving, mockup objects, photorealism, rocket or spaceship, circle cut by diagonal stripes, Cursor arrow, ChatGPT knot, Claude asterisk, generic book/cap/lightbulb, glossy gradient, glow, stock swoosh. Show a truly flat graphic, sharp edges, no paper noise. The large identity is PRIMARY, UI context secondary. Name exactly "Cadrin", pronounced CAD-rin. Proposed cadence-inspired brand about giving the learning day structure. WORDMARK-FIRST direction: do not place a generic symbol beside the name. Draw a bespoke compact architectural sans wordmark in medium weight, refined squared-round counters, a very distinct open C with one restrained inward terminal cut, clean rhythm between a/d/r/i/n. Make the C memorable enough to become the standalone app glyph, and show a small C glyph as a subordinate sample near the large wordmark. Main typography is softly engineered, not italic sports type, not a stencil. Soft white on neutral charcoal, very restrained pale lime accent only within interface. This board should look like a typography specialist's carefully drawn wordmark, not an off-the-shelf typeface and geometric badge. Two UI crops use the exact same Cadrin wordmark.
